embeds.title: 🇬🇧 🛒 Order Ticket
embeds.description:
Thanks for your interest! Please tell us:
1. Asset name(s)
2. Preferred payment method (see <#1552889293834297366>)
3. Your Roblox username

A staff member will reply shortly.

embeds.title: 🇮🇩 🛒 Tiket Pesan
embeds.description:
Terima kasih atas ketertarikanmu! Mohon sebutkan:
1. Nama asset
2. Metode pembayaran yang dipilih (lihat <#1552889293834297366>)
3. Username Roblox kamu

Staff akan segera membalas.

embeds.title: 🇬🇧 🛠️ Support Ticket
embeds.description:
Please describe your problem and include:
• Asset name
• What happened vs. what you expected
• Screenshot, video or Output logs

A staff member will reply shortly.

embeds.title: 🇮🇩 🛠️ Tiket Bantuan
embeds.description:
Jelaskan masalahmu dan sertakan:
• Nama asset
• Yang terjadi vs. yang diharapkan
• Screenshot, video, atau log Output

Staff akan segera membalas.

embeds.title: 🇬🇧 🚨 Report Ticket
embeds.description: Please describe what happened, who is involved and attach evidence (screenshots, links). Your report is only visible to staff.

embeds.title: 🇮🇩 🚨 Tiket Laporan
embeds.description: Jelaskan apa yang terjadi, siapa yang terlibat, dan lampirkan bukti (screenshot, link). Laporanmu hanya terlihat oleh staff.
